Load the stock balance, then scan.

Every barcode you scan is added to the actual count. The page shows the ERP stock next to what you counted, and the difference for every item.

Matching works on the barcode, the SKU or the item code. To count several units of one item at once, type 3*5700303037288 and press Enter.
